comments: Please review document accessibility checker for MS Office documents like word, powerpoint, excel. It is available as a free. We would appreciate if you can add this contribution for supporting communities as soon as possible.
features: Scan Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files to identify accessibility issues including missing alt text, improper heading structures, tables, reading order, color & visual content. Get a detailed report with an accessibility score, recommendations to improve document usability according to WCAG 2.1, 2.2 AA, Section 508 & support assistive technologies.
title: Free Accessibility File Checker
